name: Education
description: Qualifications-first layout for school teachers: teaching registration, classroom experience and curriculum work.
guidance: Never publish pupil-identifiable information: no names, photographs, work samples that carry a name, behaviour, attendance, special educational needs or safeguarding details, or anything that could identify a pupil, family or colleague. Check your school's and employer's policies on confidentiality and social media before publishing.

seo.aboutDescription: About {name}, {title}: training, registration and approach to teaching and learning.

summary.hint: Describe your responsibilities and outcomes in general terms. Never include pupil information.

highlights.label: Key responsibilities
highlights.hint: One per line, up to 12. No pupil details.

problem.label: Aim
problem.hint: Why the work was needed. Plain text. No pupil information.

impact.label: Outcomes
impact.hint: One outcome per line, up to 8. Whole-class or whole-school figures only, never individual pupils.

category.hint: A type such as Curriculum or Enrichment. Used by the filter on the listing page.

credentialUrl.label: Register entry link
credentialUrl.hint: Where someone can check the registration (http or https).

quote.label: Reference text
quote.hint: Plain text. Only with the referee's permission, and never any pupil information.

body.label: Article text
body.hint: Markdown. Raw HTML is shown as text, not run. Describe classroom examples in general terms only. Never include pupil information.

cover.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP. Never use a photograph that could identify a pupil, family or colleague.

heading.label: Home page introduction
heading.hint: The first thing visitors read. Write about your teaching in general terms. Never include pupil information. Changes apply as soon as you save.

eyebrow.label: Role line
eyebrow.hint: For example your phase and subject. Plain text.

heading.label: Key figures
heading.hint: General figures about your teaching, such as years of experience. Never figures about individual pupils. Changes apply as soon as you save.

heading.label: Pages of your site
heading.hint: Choose which pages the site has, what the menu calls them and in which order. Articles and workshops are off until you switch them on. Hiding a page never deletes it. Saves apply at once.

defaultOff.label: Off until you switch it on
defaultOff.hint: Not shown by default for this profession. Think about what you would publish there first.

heading.label: About you
heading.hint: Describe your teaching and values. Never include pupil information. Changes apply as soon as you save.

valueProps.label: Highlights
valueProps.hint: Short statements about how you teach, shown above the text.

heading.label: Save and restore your portfolio
heading.hint: Keep your portfolio in one file, or restore one. You see what would change first, and nothing is ever removed. Never put pupil information in an entry.

exportHeading.label: Save a copy
exportHeading.hint: One file with your details and every entry, including unpublished ones. Pictures you uploaded are listed, not included.

importHeading.label: Restore from a file
importHeading.hint: Each entry in the file is matched to one of yours by its name or title: a match is updated, anything else is added.

applyProfile.label: Also restore my details and page choices
applyProfile.hint: Left unticked, only the entries are restored. Ticked, your details, introduction, key figures, about text, template and page choices come from the file; the preview lists each change.

authoritative.label: Your content is rebuilt at every start
authoritative.hint: This site refills its content from its seed files whenever it starts, so what you restore would be replaced. Ask whoever runs the site to change that setting first.

layout.footerNote: Professional portfolio. It contains no pupil information.
